question: Should assistant avatar selection remain the persisted shared `ui.assistant.avatar` setting, or become a browser-local override like the user identity?
rationale: The PR chooses browser-local ownership, while current documentation exposes a shared persisted configuration contract; code review cannot safely decide that compatibility and cross-client behavior change.

options.title: Preserve shared assistant configuration
options.body: Keep assistant avatar persistence in `ui.assistant.avatar`, use local identity storage only for the user avatar, and fix the preview without changing the existing contract.

options.title: Adopt browser-local assistant overrides
options.body: Add canonical app-level browser storage, propagation, documentation, and upgrade behavior for assistant overrides before removing the shared configuration path.

recommendation.title: Preserve shared assistant configuration
recommendation.body: Keep assistant avatar persistence in `ui.assistant.avatar`, use local identity storage only for the user avatar, and fix the preview without changing the existing contract.
